---
title: "8.3 Calling factbox() from R"
format: typst
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{=typst}
#let factbox(title: "Fun Fact", accent: rgb("#d65a28"), fill: rgb("#fff4e8"), body) = {
  block(
    width: 100%, fill: fill, stroke: (left: 3pt + accent),
    inset: 12pt, radius: 4pt, breakable: false,
  )[
    #text(weight: "bold", size: 11.5pt, fill: accent)[#title]
    #v(0.3em)
    #body
  ]
}
```

```{r}
#| include: false
library(palmerpenguins)
typst_raw <- function(x) {
  cat("\n```{=typst}\n")
  cat(x, sep = "\n")
  cat("\n```\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
box_title <- "Key number"
box_body  <- paste0("There are ", nrow(penguins), " penguins in the data.")
typst_raw(sprintf('#factbox(title: "%s")[%s]', box_title, box_body))
```
